records.part: Purchase of Badger Meters on an as-needed basis
records.reason: the Board adopted Resolution 06-19 approving the continued standardization of water meters and meter components purchases solely to those manufactured by Badger Meter, Inc.

records.part: Purchase of HR-E Encoders to replace aging/failing meter registers and endpoints
records.reason: The failing and aging registers and endpoints are no longer manufactured and are currently being replaced with Badger HR-E Encoders and Orion Cellular Endpoints

records.part: Purchase of Orion Cellular Endpoints to replace aging/failing endpoints and for new development meters
records.reason: The failing and aging registers and endpoints are no longer manufactured and are currently being replaced with Badger HR-E Encoders and Orion Cellular Endpoints, also used on meters for new development.
